static_traits.name: Li Chengyuan
static_traits.occupation: Holds three jobs at the same time
static_traits.social_status: Has a supportive fiancée and friends, but shares troubles with them less for fear of troubling others
static_traits.medical_history: No notable physical illness; has not previously received psychotherapy; no history of similar psychological problems
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, able to identify and describe automatic thoughts, tone rather negative; relatively good cooperation, has self-reflection ability but tends to belittle positive evidence

basic_info.main_problem: Recently I am full of self-doubt and inadequacy about my dream of becoming a baseball broadcaster; juggling three jobs feels overwhelming and I worry I will never achieve my dream; this problem worsened after I proposed to my girlfriend three years ago, and the pressure of balancing work and personal life intensifies the doubt.
basic_info.core_demands: These increasing doubts and feelings of inadequacy have affected my mental health and relationships, so I seek counseling support.
growth_experiences: After proposing to his girlfriend three years ago, the pressure of balancing work and personal life intensified, and self-doubt surrounding his career ideal gradually worsened.
Long works three jobs concurrently, persistently feels time and energy overdrawn, and believes they are moving further and further away from the field of baseball broadcasting.
Whenever watching a baseball game or thinking of the career ideal, the client is struck by the thought 'I will never reach it', and negative emotions and self-doubt recur daily.
Once took action for the dream: took related courses and did some industry networking, but tends to regard these efforts as 'insignificant'.
Has a supportive fiancee and friends, but because of worrying about adding burden to others, tends to bear problems alone.

core_beliefs: I am not good enough/not够胜任。
No matter how hard I try, I cannot achieve my dream.

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I still have not entered the baseball broadcasting industry by now, it means I will never succeed.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces themselves to stay positive, occasionally enrolls in classes to study and makes social attempts, while continuing high-intensity work to prove their effort.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot become a baseball broadcaster, I will never get there.

special_situations.event: Situations of working three jobs at once and feeling time slipping away
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If no obvious big progress is seen in the short term, it means I have no value or did not work hard enough.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continues working desperately to relieve unease and self-doubt, trying to prove the self through output.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Time is almost up, I have already missed the opportunity, it will only get worse later.

special_situations.event: Reviews the steps already taken (took courses, did some network expansion)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only reaching the final big goal counts as progress, small steps do not count.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring or negating one's own effort, focusing attention on what has not been achieved.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: None of this counts for anything; it is insignificant compared to the goal.

special_situations.event: When wanting to confide stress and doubts to a fiancee or friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I express stress and needs, I will become a burden to others and appear very weak.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Chooses to bear it alone and does not proactively seek support or comfort.
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is my problem; I should solve it myself.

core_conflict.wish: In relationships where they are understood and supported, pursues and realizes the dream of becoming a baseball broadcaster and a sense of self-worth.
core_conflict.fear: Fears failure, fears disappointing significant others or becoming a burden, and worries that exposing vulnerability will be seen as weakness.
defense_goal: Reduces the risk of being rejected or disappointing others by taking things on alone and restraining help-seeking
Maintains a sense of control over the self with high standards and belittling progress, avoiding facing feelings of failure

object_relations.self_representation: A dream-chaser who must shoulder everything alone and may not be good enough
object_relations.object_representation: Significant others (fiancée, friends) who may be burdened by me and would be disappointed by my vulnerability

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor encourages Li Chengyuan to express his troubles to his fiancée / friends or seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes seeking help will trouble the other party and show that they are not strong enough (transference: worrying about being seen as weak or a burden)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizes 'this is my responsibility' in a calm and rational tone, states reasons such as not having enough time and the other person being busy, avoiding expressing vulnerability and dependency needs.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor affirms the steps already completed (courses, network expansion) and explores their meaning
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Separating objective progress from positive emotions, viewing them as unimportant or irrelevant
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Downplays achievements through objective statements, with a steady tone, avoiding connecting with positive feelings or self-affirmation.

manifestations: Emphasizes 'I should be able to handle it myself', fully internalizing choices and responsibilities as personal burdens
Still insisting on bearing alone in three jobs and a high-pressure pace, unwilling to seek help
outcomes: The relationship is affected, intimate communication decreases

manifestations: Knows there is a support system (fiancee, friends), but reduces expression and help-seeking due to worrying about 'becoming a burden'
Tends to bear key issues alone
outcomes: 主观Sense of isolation、without助感上升

manifestations: Regards the courses taken and networking done as insignificant
Frequently having daily experience covered by the belief 'I will never achieve it'
outcomes: Daily self-care and work focus impaired

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Repeatedly using the self-demand 'I should be able to handle it myself'
Believing seeking help from others equals troubling people, is a sign of weakness

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains behavioral impulses originally directed at others and instead acts on the self, turning energy from outward to inward, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Turning the impulse to seek support outward into self-imposed high pressure and self-demands
Continuously juggling three jobs, suppressing the expression of needs

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection, involving excessive self-restriction and self-reproach, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly emphasizes in counseling that one is inadequate and progress is negligible
Remaining highly cautious about expressing needs and requesting support

exception_events.target_problem: When watching baseball or thinking about his career ideal, Li Chengyuan usually falls into the thought 'I will never reach it', with low mood and reduced action.
exception_events.unique_outcome: In one broadcasting-related course study session, he did not immerse himself in self-negation as usual, but completed the learning tasks, taking a small step toward the goal.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: breaking long-term goals into executable learning steps; different context: the structured course environment helped them focus on the present task.

positive_force: Having a supportive fiancee and friends
Having taken relevant courses and done some networking, having a foundation for action
Persistence and diligence (able to hold three jobs over a long period)
Willing to try reality testing and action plans
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, filtering out the positive, and overgeneralization
Strong 'should' beliefs and avoidance of seeking help, worrying about becoming a burden to others
Energy consumption and sense of hopelessness brought by long-term high pressure and sense of urgency
Discounting small progress, difficulty internalizing positive evidence
Baseball-related cues easily trigger rumination and low mood

target_behavior.behavior: Repetitive negative self-talk and catastrophic thinking (such as 'I will never reach it')
antecedent: 思考not yet来职业与梦想
Reviewing progress while under work pressure and fatigue
target_behavior.core_reason: Based on the core belief 'I am not good enough / cannot succeed' and cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, all-or-nothing thinking, and overgeneralization.
target_behavior.function: Gains in the short term a sense of control and self-protection, avoiding facing uncertainty and potential failure.
target_behavior.consequence: Low mood, focus and work performance impaired, daily self-care disrupted, relationships strained.

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids seeking support and expressing emotions to fiancee or friends
antecedent: When intense stress or self-doubt arises
When there is a chance to confide in someone close
target_behavior.core_reason: The introjected rule and shame that 'seeking help will burden others and appear weak'.
target_behavior.function: Avoids the risk of being evaluated or rejected, maintaining control and independence of self-image.
target_behavior.consequence: Subjective isolation increases, negative emotions accumulate, the problem keeps worsening and affects intimate relationships.
